summary.whatChanges: In the AWS Lambda adapter, query-string building for API Gateway v1 and ALB events now keeps parameters whose value is an empty string, filtering only `undefined` values instead of all falsy ones. Tests were added covering both event types.
behaviorChanges: Query parameters with empty values (e.g. ?empty=) are now included in the reconstructed request URL for API Gateway v1.0 events
Query parameters with empty values are now included for ALB events
Parameters with undefined values continue to be dropped
risks: Handlers that previously never saw empty-valued query params may now branch differently (e.g. presence checks on flags like ?debug=)
ALB branch still interpolates key/value without URL encoding, so encoding behavior is unchanged and inconsistent with the v1 branch
